description: This file defines a command handler class 'UpdateAccountNumberFormatCommandHandler' that processes update commands for account number formats within the Apache Fineract project. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and delegates the update operation to 'AccountNumberFormatWritePlatformService'.

classes.name: UpdateAccountNumberFormatCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles update commands for account number formats, utilizing dependency injection and transaction management.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command to update an account number format by delegating to the platform service.
